founderNoteBody:
Muli shani, niine Levi. Natampile ukupanga WitnessWork mu 2023 pa kupwisha amafya ayo nakwete nine umwine ilyo nale piyona. Icatampile fye nge cilangililo icapwe kunchitilwe nge cibombelo capalama capalama, capangilwe pa lwa ushiku ushingi no kushinguluka.

donate_letter:
Dear Brother or Sister,

I am very honored that you have chosen my app to use in the sea of other amazing choices. I started working on this app when I was pioneering - I just couldn't find a clear and concise place to keep my notes. For me, it felt like I would always lose my paper notes and somehow forget my return visits. I knew a lot of other people felt the same way. My goal when creating this app was to focus on high utility but also simplicity. Anyone should be able to use this app, no matter their age or publisher experience. I hope my app has been a useful tool for you and your service to Jehovah. I have spent countless hours developing this app, and I am very happy to see it being used by so many brothers and sisters around the world. If you haven't already, please let others know about WitnessWork - it's a labor of love. Regardless if you choose to donate, I hope you continue to enjoy the app and the future updates.

Thank you,

Levi Wilkerson

autoRollover_description:
Umweshi onse uleshila na maminiti panono ayashili apangaiapo awala yapwa — nge 34 ama-awala na 24 amaminiti. Na ici nga cabilishiwa, amaminiti ya kulundako yasendwa ku bushiku bwantanshi bwa mweshi uukonkapo pa kuti lipoti shaikalile pa ama-awala fye yapwa.

Mukamona ma entries yabili yalingana ayo yalembwa nga rollover: kamo pa bushiku bwa kupelekeshepo bwa mweshi wapwilile ukufunda amaminiti, na kamo pa bushiku bwantanshi bwa mweshi mupya ukulundakapo. Ayo yabili yacanwa lyonse — takuli inshita iyatuma nelyo iyalufiwa.

Ilyo ici cashima, mukapokelela uupokelelo umo pa kutampa kwa mweshi onse ileisa ukwipusha nga mulefwaya ukubwesha.

Ku pioneers abalonda icalandwilwe ca mwaka, rollover taipita aka kabikulu ka mwaka wa mulimo wa September — cila cilengelo ca mwaka citampa pa ama-awala fye yapwa.

faq_timeRollover_q: cita yandi inshita mu nshila ya iyo ine roll ukucila uku mweshi ukwisa?
faq_timeRollover_a: Ee. Amaawala ayashele panshi ya ico mwapanga ukufikapo cila mweshi kuti yaya ku mweshi ukonkelepo. Isuleni Ifyo Mwasala → Kasabankanya no kubika pa ukusenda amaawala. Amaawala ayasendwa yalamoneka yene ilyo umweshi upya watampa, e ico tamwakabilwa ukufumyapo nelyo ukulemba libili.
faq_bibleStudies_q: Bushe amasambililo ya Baibolo yapendwa shani?
faq_bibleStudies_a: Amasambililo yalakonkelelwa pa muntu, te pa bushiku. Pa kuti isambililo lipendwe, isuleni umuntu, lembeni ukulanshanya, no kubika icishibilo ca kuti "Natungulula isambililo lya Baibolo." Umuntu uyo akapendwa nge sambililo 1 pa mweshi uno, nangu ca kuti mwalisambilila na wene inshita ishingi. Pa kuti mulundeko impendwa ya masambililo, bikeni icishibilo ca sambililo pa muntu umbi.
faq_iCloudSync_q: kuti ine linganya yandi ifyebo pakati yandi iPhone na iPad?
faq_iCloudSync_a: Ee. Ukulinganya na iCloud kulalenga ifyalembwa fyenu fya nshita, abantu ba kutandalila, ne fyo mwalanshanya ukulingana pa fibombelo fya iOS ukwabula imwe ukubomba. Cikuleni muli Ifyo mwasala → Ukulinganya na iCloud. Ukulinganya na iCloud caba fye ku Bafwilisha.
faq_widgets_q: ni uko intendekelo nelyo lock icilangililo widgets?
faq_widgets_a: ee, pa iOS. citali-tinikeni yenu intendekelo nelyo lock icilangililo, tinikeni + ibotoni, fwaya pa lwa WitnessWork, na sala widget imwe fwaya. ama-awala widget shows yenu cila mweshi ukwenda pantanshi pa glance.
faq_switchingPioneer_q: Bushe ningacinja shani ukufuma pali Kasabankanya ukuya kuli Painia wa Kwafwilisha pakati ka mweshi?
faq_switchingPioneer_a: Isuleni Ifyo Mwasala → Umusango wa Kasabankanya no kusala ico calinga nomba: Kasabankanya, Painia wa Kwafwilisha, Painia wa Nshita Yonse, Painia Waibela, Kangalila wa Muputule, nelyo Custom. Ifyo mwapanga ukufikapo ne fyonse pamo fikacinja ukulingana na co. Bwelelapo ilyo mwapwisha. Imyeshi yapita ilasunga inshita iyo mwalembele, e ico ifyacitika fyenu fikaba fya cine.
faq_submitReport_q: Bushe app ilatuma lipoti yandi ya mulimo?
faq_submitReport_a: Iyo. WitnessWork ilateyanya fye inshita yenu ne fyalanshanya. Inshila mwatuma lipoti yenu no muntu uo mwaipeela ni mwe na komiti ya mulimo ya cilonganino cenu mukasala. Kuti mwakopolola amashiwi ayapelenganya, mwatumina pali Hourglass, nelyo mwaisula NW Publisher ukufuma mu cipapatu ca kutumina ifyebo.
faq_remainingHours_q: shani cita ine mona shani many ama-awala ine have ukumwela mweshi uno nelyo umwaka?
faq_remainingHours_a: Isuleni tab ya Ukwenda Pantanshi pa panshi. Icilangililo ca Mweshi cilanga inshita mwabomba ne maawala ayashala pa mweshi uno. Bapainia kuti bacinja ku cilangililo ca Mwaka pa kumona ifyo baleya pa co bapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka, inshita babomba, amaawala ayashala, ne fyalembwa fya cila mweshi ifilinganya amaawala ya cine na yapangilwe.
faq_goalPacing_q: shani kuti ine tell nga I'm kuntanshi nelyo kunuma pa yandi awala ico mwapanga ukufikapo?
faq_goalPacing_a: Isuleni tab ya Ukwenda Pantanshi pa panshi. Icilangililo ca Mweshi cilanga ico mufwile ukubomba cila bushiku pa kuti mumone nga muli munshila iyalungama pa mweshi uno. Bapainia kuti bacinja ku cilangililo ca Mwaka pa kumona bwangu ifyo cila mweshi caleya pa co bapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka.
faq_timeFormat_q: kuti ine display inshita nga "1h 30m" mu nshita ya "1.5"?
faq_timeFormat_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → Appearance na sala yenu preferred inshita umukolwe. Both formats ni cilipo everywhere inshita ni shown.
faq_weekStart_q: kuti ine tampa umulungu pa Monday mu nshita ya Sunday?
faq_weekStart_a: ee. ifyo mwasala → Appearance lets imwe sala ica ntanshi bushiku wa umulungu. cinja cibomba uku kalenda, ubupange, na cili conse fimbi cila mulungu views.
faq_darkMode_q: Bushe kuti nasala ukubomfya icafita nelyo ulubuuto?
faq_darkMode_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → Appearance → ulupala Scheme na sala System, Light, nelyo Dark. cibombelo ka leka following yenu phone's setting na bomfya cimo imwe sala.
faq_appIcon_a: Ee. Isuleni Ifyo mwasala → Icishibilo ca cibombelo, e lyo musale pa fishibilo ifili ko. Ifishibilo fimbi fyaba fye ku Bafwilisha.
faq_reorderHome_q: kuti ine reorder cards pa yandi intendekelo icilangililo?
faq_reorderHome_a: ee. isula ifyo mwasala → intendekelo icilangililo uku langa, fisa, na reorder cards. intendekelo icilangililo ka sunga yenu ifyo mwasala layout going kuntanshi.
faq_timerRounding_q: mulandu nshi cali yandi timer rounded uku nearest 5 imineti?
faq_timerRounding_a: ico cali icikale behavior. ica nomba versions sunga cacine stopwatch inshita ilyo imwe leka timer, na no rounding. nga muli nomba line seeing 5-mineti rounding, lundulula cibombelo uku latest version.
faq_addNotesToTime_q: Bushe kuti nalundapo ifyebo ku calembwa ca nshita?
faq_addNotesToTime_a: ee. ilyo imwe lundapo nelyo lungika icalembwa ca nshita, kuti mwa attach akashiwi (e.g. "cart witnessing" nelyo "cut cipi"). kuti mwa na kabili tag ifyalembwa na amalupange efyo similar ifyalembwa stay grouped mu inshita yenu malipoti.
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_q: Ndi painia waibela, mulandu nshi app ilelanga ico mpanga ukufikapo mu mwaka?
faq_specialPioneerAnnual_a: Bapainia baibela tabakwata ico bapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka. Nga cenu cilemoneka, isuleni Ifyo Mwasala → Kasabankanya no kufumya ico mwapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka. Ico mwapanga ukufikapo cila mweshi cikashala, no mulongo wa mwaka pa cilangililo ca Mwaka mu tab ya Ukwenda Pantanshi ukafiswa.
faq_ldcCreditCap_q: Bushe LDC na maawala yambi ya credit yalundwa mu fyonse pamo fyandi?
faq_ldcCreditCap_a: Ee. Amaawala ya credit yalapendwa mu maawala yenu ya cila mweshi. Pa fyonse pamo fya mwaka wa mulimo, amaawala ya credit ukufika pa 55 pa mweshi yalapendwa, ukulingana ne cipimo ico ofeshi ya musambo yabika. Conse icacila pa cipimo cilashala pa cilembwa lelo tacilundwa pa fyonse pamo fya mwaka.
faq_timezoneShift_q: ka yandi ifyalembwa fya nshita nelyo ubupange shift inshiku nga ine travel pakati timezones?
faq_timezoneShift_a: No. nga wa April 2026 lundulula, cila icalembwa ca nshita na ubupange ni anchored uku ya ici kalenda ubushiku independent wa timezone, efyo traveling nelyo crossing daylight-ukusunga boundary ka te senda ifyalembwa uku calekana bushiku. Older ifyalembwa capangwa kale ico lundulula ni migrated mu nshila ya iyo ine ica ntanshi inshita imwe isula icipya version. nga imwe ever spot icalembwa pa icilubo bushiku panuma ukulungulula, mukwai tuma ubupusano lipoti na tuka senda mona.
faq_editRecurringPlan_q: kuti ine lungika nelyo fumyapo single occurrence wa ubupange ububwekeshapo?
faq_editRecurringPlan_a: ee. isula ubupange tab, tinikeni bushiku imwe fwaya uku cinja, na sala "lungika" nelyo "fumyapo" pa lwa ico occurrence. yenu ubupange ububwekeshapo stays intact pa lwa cila fimbi bushiku.
faq_awayDay_q: shani cita ine mark bushiku I'm te going panse ukwabula breaking yandi ubupange ububwekeshapo?
faq_awayDay_a: tinikeni bushiku pa ubupange tab na lundapo override pa lwa "ukutali" nelyo mwapolamo bushiku. override fye affects ico cimo bushiku, na ubupange ububwekeshapo keeps going ukufuma icakonkapo bushiku kuntanshi.
faq_importContacts_q: kuti ine kuleta ifyebo abantu ba kutandalila ukufuma yandi phone's adiresi book?
faq_importContacts_a: Te pa nshita ino. Abantu ba kulanshanya balembwa ku maboko muli WitnessWork. Ici cilenga abantu benu ba mu mulimo wa kushimikila basungwe inkama kabili cilecefya ukuleta abantu benu bambi mu kupumfyanya.
faq_importOtherApps_q: Bushe kuti naleta ifyebo ukufuma mu MyTime, Ministry Assistant, nelyo app imbi?
faq_importOtherApps_a: te panse wa box. Most fimbi apps store ifyebo mu proprietary nelyo obfuscated formats, na tatu reverse-engineer bo. simplest path pa lwa onse ni uku mwe bene re-panga yenu cilebomba abantu ba kutandalila mu WitnessWork, elyo kunuma pamulu regularly going kuntanshi. nga muli experienced developer na fwaya uku roll yenu own pipeline, go pa lwa ici. WitnessWork ifyasungwa ni plain JSON na denormalized, human-readable structure, na uko cafuma ni isula pa github.com/leviFrosty/witness-umulimo. mona src/types (uwa kutandalila.ts, ukulanshanya.ts, serviceReport.ts, etc.) pa lwa canonical types you'd kabila uku match pa both ends. Just ba aware ici isn't officially supported path: ifwe won't afwilisha debug yenu importer, na types kuti cinja pakati releases.
faq_backupRestore_q: Bushe kuti nasunga no kubwesha ifyebo fyandi shani?
faq_backupRestore_a: isula ifyo mwasala → ifyasungwa uku kutumamo ifyebo ukusunga file. sunga ici uku iCloud Drive, ama file, nelyo anywhere else, elyo pa icipya icibombelo tinikeni "kuleta ifyebo" na sala file. nga bweshapo looks incomplete, mukwai imelo Levi privately na ukusunga file attached na tuka afwilisha. bomfya imelo link pa panshi wa ici icilangililo.
faq_shareAddress_q: shani cita ine poka inshila uku uwa kutandalila?
faq_shareAddress_a: isula uwa kutandalila na tinikeni yabo adiresi. muka ba offered Apple Maps, Google Maps, nelyo Waze depending pa what's installed. kuti mwa na kabili icishibilo ca pa mapu contact's uko muli ukwabula adiresi, ico ni useful pa lwa areas uko street numbers don't exist.
faq_manualPin_q: yandi icishibilo ca pa mapu ni mu icilubo place. kuti ine senda ici?
faq_manualPin_a: ee. isula contact's adiresi icilangililo na kokoleni icishibilo ca pa mapu uku correct spot. kuti mwa na kabili place icishibilo ca pa mapu ukwabula adiresi pa fyonse, ico ni helpful mu areas ukwabula precise geolocation ifyebo.
faq_profilePic_q: kuti ine lundapo icikope uku uwa kutandalila?
faq_profilePic_a: ee. isula uwa kutandalila, tinikeni avatar, na sala icikope ukufuma yenu library nelyo senda icipya cimo. ici ni especially handy ilyo abantu ba kutandalila akanya names nelyo ilyo icikope helps imwe spot ukulyo door.
faq_dismissContact_q: shani cita ine fisa uwa kutandalila ukwabula ukufumyapo bo?
faq_dismissContact_a: isula uwa kutandalila na tinikeni "Dismiss." muka sala shani citali uku dismiss bo pa lwa (1 umulungu, 1 mweshi, 3 imyeshi, 6 imyeshi, nelyo 1 umwaka). uwa kutandalila disappears ukufuma yenu cilebomba lists pa lwa ico inshita na elyo comes kunuma mu nshila ya iyo ine ilyo inshita ni pamulu. nga ifyakucenjezya ni casuminishiwa, muka na kabili poka icakukumbushanya ilyo bo reappear, efyo caleshiwa abantu ba kutandalila won't quietly slip ukupitila cracks. kuti mwa sanga nelyo bweshapo caleshiwa abantu ba kutandalila inshita yonse panshi ifyo mwasala → caleshiwa abantu ba kutandalila.
faq_reportBug_q: shani cita ine lipoti ubupusano nelyo request icibomfya?
faq_reportBug_a: tinikeni cimo wa buttons panshi uku isula ubupusano lipoti nelyo icibomfya request directly. malipoti ico lundamo screenshot, icibombelo cenu + iOS version, na WitnessWork version (shown pa panshi wa ifyo mwasala) ni easiest uku fix quickly.
faq_becomeSupporter_a: Abafwilisha ba cila mweshi bapokelela akashibilo ka Uwafwilisha ne nshila shinono shimbi isha kuipangila cibombelo — lelo kuli ulupala lwa kubalisha ulwa pa lwenu, e lyo ifimbi fikeisa mu kuya kwa nshita. Ukulinganya ifyebo fyenu pa fibombelo fyonse ukupitila muli iCloud e cintu cikalamba icakonkelepo ku Bafwilisha, cileisa nomba line. Ubupe bwa nshita imo na bo bwalitashiwa nga nshi, lelo tabupeela ukuba Uwafwilisha uwa lyonse.
faq_stillFree_q: ni WitnessWork nomba line ya uluse?
faq_stillFree_a: ee — na inshita yonse cika. cila core icibomfya stays ya uluse pa lwa onse. Supporting ni completely nga mulefwaya; ici helps fund ongoing development na unlocks few ica imwe touches nga natotela-imwe.
faq_stopSupporting_q: finshi happens nga ine leka supporting?
faq_stopSupporting_a: Takuli icingacinja pa fyebo fyenu. Nga ukulipila kwa cila mweshi kwapwa, ifya kuipangila ifya Bafwilisha fyonse fibwelela ku fyaba lyonse — lipoti shenu, abantu ba kutandalila, ifyebo, ne fyo mwasala fikashala ifyo fine fyaba.
faq_acceptDonations_q: mulandu nshi ni imwe accepting ifya bupe?
faq_acceptDonations_a: Nga munyinefwe mu Ng'anda ya Bufumu, mmona kwati ni nsansa ukubomfya amano yandi pa kwafwilisha bambi mu cilonganino. Nangu ca kuti app iyi ya kubula ukulipila kuli bonse, ukuipanga, ukuibomfya no kuisunga kulafwaya indalama ishingi ne nshita iikalamba. Mmona ukupeela indalama kwati ni filya umo engalipilila peleto wa munankwe panuma ya kuya mu mulimo na wene - kucita kwa kutemwa uko batasha nga nshi.
faq_donationsUsedFor_q: finshi ni ifya bupe cabomfiwa pa lwa?
faq_donationsUsedFor_a: yenu ca bupe helps keeps ici cibombelo running! uko ni costs na purchasing real ifibombelo nga development equipment, paying pa lwa uko muli API umulimo fees, build umulimo API fees, cibombelo store fees, na opportunity cost wa yandi many ama-awala spent developing ici cibombelo. cila piece wa ukwafwilisha ni greatly appreciated!
faq_whatsNew_q: uko kuti ine mona finshi cacinja mu latest lundulula?
faq_whatsNew_a: ifyo mwasala → What's icipya shows summary wa ica nomba changes. Major updates na kabili pop pamulu cimo-inshita "What's icipya" sheet ica ntanshi inshita imwe isula cibombelo panuma ukulungulula.
